paragraphs: Personalized outpatient mental health services in Los Angeles – Mid Wilshire supporting those impacted by anxiety, depression, addiction, or trauma.
Beverly Hills, Malibu, West Hollywood, Koreatown, Culver City, Hollywood Hills, Beverly Grove, Mid-City
Located in the Mid-Wilshire neighborhood of Los Angeles, our outpatient treatment center is designed to feel familiar, fostering comfort, healing, and a sense of community.

Our holistic approach integrates therapeutic programs and experiential treatments to support your whole self. Your dedicated team works one-on-one with you to uncover and address the root causes of your challenges.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Often considered disorganized or flighty, those with ADHD and learning disorders need professional support to maintain concentration.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
The compassionate clinical team at Clear Behavioral Health works with you to determine the specialized outpatient or residential services that will work best for you today and every step of the way.

Our adult outpatient program supports individuals managing anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges. With flexible scheduling and a coordinated approach that combines therapy and psychiatry, we help you …

Our teen mental health Program is designed for adolescents facing emotional or behavioral challenges. With age-appropriate care, individual and family therapy, and support for managing school-life balance, we help teens …

At Clear Behavioral Health, we’re not just experts in treating your mental health. We’re adept at helping you navigate your insurance to facilitate treatment, accepting most major insurance and plans. Call today and let us help you through the maze.
Let us help you through the maze.
Our thoughtfully designed, in-network mental health and addiction programs are delivered affordably in a comfortable setting nearby, or online across California.

Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our medically supervised detox program provides 24/7 care in a safe, supportive environment for people withdrawing from drugs or alcohol. With continuous monitoring and evidence-based safety protocols, we help manage withdrawal symptoms and prepare clients for the next step in recovery.

Our residential rehab program offers full-time, structured care for individuals recovering from substance use, either following detox or as a primary treatment. With an average stay of 30+ days, clients receive daily therapy, medical support, relapse prevention planning, and holistic services in a supportive environment.

Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

The teen years are complicated for everyone and impact an entire family. If you are concerned that your teen is experiencing significant mental health or addiction issues, Clear Behavioral Health’s team of compassionate adolescent mental health experts can help.

We specialize in a range of affordable and flexible teen-focused services to meet the needs of each unique adolescent, addressing mental health challenges and unhealthy coping mechanisms by treating underlying causes and contributing factors, such as attitudes, values and family dynamics. Together, we’ll work with you to determine which services will work best for your teen.
Clear Behavioral Health has supported the wellbeing of clients throughout Southern California for over a decade.
Convenient, affordable, immediate, and easy to obtain
Expert clinical care centered around your unique & evolving goals
Deep local support from your care team and peers, today and tomorrow

Welcome to Clear Behavioral Health’s outpatient mental health service Los Angeles center, where your mental health and well-being are our top priorities. Our warm and inviting facility is thoughtfully designed to provide a safe, structured, and healing environment for individuals and families. With private therapy rooms, comfortable group spaces, and dedicated school support areas for teens, we create a supportive setting tailored to meet diverse needs.

Our center also features wellness amenities to promote holistic healing and offers inclusive services such as all-gender restrooms and culturally sensitive programming to ensure everyone feels respected and valued. At Clear Behavioral Health Los Angeles, you’ll find compassionate care in a nurturing space dedicated to helping you on your journey toward lasting wellness.

We’re located on the third floor of the business center. Enter the parking garage — the gate will open automatically. Parking is free once you check in at the front desk. Enter through the ground floor entrance, visit the front desk to check in and provide your car details, then take the elevator to the third floor. You’ll find us in Suite 386.

Care is only as effective as the experts providing it, and we’re not shy about telling the world that some of the best in the business are right here at Clear Behavioral Health. But don’t just take our word for it – get to know them yourselves.

mainEntity.name: Can I work or go to school while in outpatient treatment in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your treatment program will determine whether it is possible for you to continue attending school or work while receiving treatment. We’ll shape a program that focuses first and foremost on your health, then on helping you fulfill your commitments while receiving treatment.

mainEntity.name: Is Clear Behavioral Health Los Angeles outpatient treatment center LGBTQ+ affirming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes – Clear Behavioral Health is LGBTQ+ affirming, and welcoming to all. Mental health doesn’t discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, creed/religion or age – neither do we.

mainEntity.name: How long is outpatient therapy at your Los Angeles location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment plans are personalized to you, not the other way around. Your outpatient therapy plan is designed with the objective of helping you get well, not putting a predetermined timeline on that process. Typical treatment programs last anywhere from several sessions to multiple weeks of treatment, with one or more sessions per week.

mainEntity.name: Do you accept Medi-Cal or PPO insurance at your Los Angeles facility?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can find out more about the insurance that Clear accepts here. We encourage you to get in touch to discuss your mental health needs, even if you’re unsure or worried about what insurance may or may not cover. We’ll help you understand what’s covered and are experts at helping you navigate the insurance landscape to find options that work with your plan.

mainEntity.name: How much does outpatient mental health treatment cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment cost varies depending on insurance coverage and specific program details and duration. Contact Us to discuss your needs and we’ll help you understand what is covered or not and what out-of-pocket costs may exist for your specific program.
